about_the_game:
Alegraz plunges you into a shadowy world of ever-changing dungeons, where you must rely on strategy, cunning, and a carefully constructed deck of cards to survive. Every attempt (run) offers new enemies, cards, and relics, ensuring no two playthroughs are the same. When you’re defeated, you don’t lose everything—thanks to the “rebirth” mechanic, you’ll come back with permanent upgrades and new cards, making each subsequent run more powerful than the last.

Features

Roguelite Gameplay

Experience procedurally generated dungeons, enemies, and loot that guarantee a fresh challenge every time you play.

Strategic Card Battles

Build and refine your deck. Use your cards wisely and set up combos to outmaneuver your foes.

Powerful Items & Upgrades

Discover rare items, unique power-ups, and new cards as you progress. Experiment with different strategies each run.

Rebirth System

Death is not the end. Rise again with permanent boosts and extra cards to aid you in your next attempt.

Challenging Boss Fights

Face off against formidable bosses, each with distinct weaknesses and patterns. Find their flaws and exploit them to claim victory.

Endless Replayability

With randomized encounters, evolving card combinations, and tough enemies, every run is a new experience.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 x64 Bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4670K / AMD FX-4350
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 760 (2048 MB) Radeon R7 260X (2048 MB Intel UHD Graphics 630
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Low Quality setting, in 1080p, producing 60 FPS
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11 x64 Bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-9600 / AMD Ryzen 5 1600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 1080 (8192 MB) Radeon RX 5700 (8192 MB)
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: High Quality setting, in 1080p, producing 60 FPS

short_description: Alegraz is a roguelite strategy card game set in dark dungeons. Each run features new cards, enemies, and powerful items. Build unique combos to advance, and when you fail, resurrect even stronger!

English*, Turkish
